en: A monochrome commemorative postcard featuring a central oval portrait of a bald man with a beard and glasses, framed by laurel leaves. Above the portrait appears a star with the dates "1912" and "1913" around it, and Greek text curving along the top. On the left side is the Greek flag, and on the right side another flag (likely Balkan ally). At the bottom, more Greek text identifies him as prime minister during the Greek‑Turkish wars, with his name signed below. There is also a circular seal-like mark and a small printed number in the corner.
